weekly_archive.title: Crypto Long & Short:  Inside the 300-to-1 onchain gap between the dollar and euro
weekly_archive.description: Ryan Connor of RockawayX writes that the dollar leads the euro about 3 to 1 across the offchain economy and more than 300 to 1 onchain. Euro-pegged stablecoins total €711 million, under 1% of supply. He traces the gap to path dependency and missing euro DeFi infrastructure, and argues MiCA-regulated issuance and euro vault rails are changing it.

weekly_archive.title: MoneyGram unveils stablecoin-backed card as digital dollars move into everyday spending
weekly_archive.description: The remittance giant is rolling out a Visa card that lets customers hold dollars and spend from a stablecoin-backed balance.
weekly_archive.summary: MoneyGram is launching a Visa card backed by stablecoins, signaling a major step toward mainstream adoption of digital dollars for everyday purchases.
